info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Tetrahed Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Tetrahed Notebook Detail Management API allows users to add new details for Tetrahed notebooks in the catalog. This endpoint is essential for managing product specifications, features, and variations, facilitating a comprehensive catalog update. It is particularly useful for retailers and product managers looking to enhance their inventory with detailed product information. By utilizing this API, developers can seamlessly integrate catalog updates into their applications, ensuring that consumers have access to the latest product details.
